Product:{\"sku\":\"7100130703\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Hotel Empire - Check Inn is a charming management simulation in which you build your own hotel chain step by step. Start with a small, simple hotel and expand your empire into more and more cities – each with its own challenges.

BUILD, EXPAND, AND OPTIMIZE
- Build new hotels, buy building plots.
- Plan rooms with increasingly complex shapes and place them as efficiently as possible.
- Fulfill your guests' wishes: they want specific rooms and parking spaces.

MANAGE STAFF & SERVICE
- Hire enough maids, because every room must be cleaned after check-out.
- Build elevators, upgrade them, and keep them in good condition so guests can quickly reach their floor.
- Build service rooms such as kitchens, laundries, or saunas, and employ porters who transport food, laundry, and other items through the hotel.

EVERY CITY BRINGS NEW CHALLENGES
- Montreal: Cold, snowy weather – insulate rooms so guests don't freeze.
- Miami: Luxury hotels right by the sea with especially demanding room layouts.
- New York: Build several hotels at the same time and use managers who automate check-in.

EASY TO LEARN - HARD TO MASTER
Hotel Empire - Check Inn combines accessible gameplay with a deep management focus. Optimize processes, keep guests happy, and expand your hotel chain into a global empire.
